What speed means  
Speed tells how fast an object moves. It is the distance traveled divided by the time it took: speed = distance ÷ time.  

Units  
If distance is in kilometers (km) and time is in hours (h), speed is in kilometers per hour (km/h). If distance is in meters (m) and time is in seconds (s), speed is in meters per second (m/s). Example: a jeepney travels 30 km in 1 hour, so its speed is 30 km/h.  

Problems  
Find the speed. 1) A tricycle travels 12 km in 0.5 hour. 2) A runner covers 100 m in 20 s. 3) A bus travels 180 km in 3 hours.
